stories.title: Islamabad hosts foreign dignitaries for two-day ECO ministerial meeting
stories.brief: Foreign dignitaries arrived in Islamabad on Sunday as Pakistan hosts the two-day 30th meeting of the Economic Cooperation Organisation (ECO) Council of Ministers, starting today. Addressing the gathering, DPM Dar also reaffirmed Pakistan’s commitment to “regional cooperation and advancing shared aspirations for peace, progress and prosperity”.

stories.title: In call with Fazl, Bilawal condemns 'govt actions, political vengeance' against JUI-F
stories.brief: SWABI/CHARSADDA: PPP Chairman Bilawal Bhutto-Zardari on Sunday spoke to Jamiat Ulema-i-Islam-Fazl chief Maulana Fazlur Rehman and condemned the “government’s actions” against him. The past month has witnessed exchanges of harsh remarks between Fazl and federal ministers, after the JUI-F chief accused the Centre of depriving the provinces of their rights.

stories.title: FM Dar calls for stronger regional cooperation as Pakistan hosts ECO ministerial meeting
stories.brief: According to FO, senior officials from Azerbaijan, Kazakhstan and Turkiye, along with representatives of the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) and the Organisation of Islamic Cooperation (OIC), arrived in Islamabad to attend the 30th ECO Council of Ministers Meeting.
